instruction: Cinematic film still, medium eye-level tracking shot. Outdoors next to a brick building with large windows, the man in the maroon zip-up hoodie (R2) with a yellow backpack walks on the left, gesturing forward with his right hand and smiling as he speaks. Beside him on the right, the woman in the maroon puffer jacket (R1) with a white backpack walks forward, looking ahead with a neutral, listening expression. They walk side-by-side from left to right in soft natural daylight, casting subtle shadows on the warm brick wall behind them.
